placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Abbots Pool is a place for a short, observant walk rather than a busy programme of activities. The water and surrounding woodland give children plenty to look at while the family enjoys some time outdoors.

Our family idea: stop on the path and look for reflections on the water, then compare the trees on either side. Keep your visit gentle and leave plants, fallen timber and wildlife undisturbed.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy quiet woodland and waterside scenery.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Woodland paths around the pool; plan refreshments and toilet stops elsewhere.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Follow the parish council's visitor guidance and park only in permitted areas.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The pool is for looking at, not swimming. Keep children close to adults beside the water and expect uneven or muddy woodland paths.
